prose: A team building an AI receptionist for a maintenance company describes retrieval failures: a caller asking about a leaking plumber's repair was handed the wrong web page by embedding search. They report that Jev, TypeSafe's judge, handed the model the wrong page about a tenth as often as embeddings did. Basis: the opening of the post.
highlights: Embedding retrieval gave wrong pages for real caller questions.
Reports a roughly 10x lower wrong-page rate using Jev.
Use case: AI receptionist for a multi-trade company.
